summary: Configured 512MB zstd-compressed zram swap on node1 via Alpine's zram-init package, enabled it in the default OpenRC runlevel so it activates at boot, and validated it survives a full node reboot with the same configuration and max swap priority (preferred over any disk-backed swap).
actions_performed: Inspected node1: confirmed Alpine Linux 3.23, no existing swap, zram kernel module present
Installed zram-init (13.0.1-r2) and zram-init-openrc via apk
Edited /etc/conf.d/zram-init: reduced num_devices to 1, kept type0=swap, size0=512 (MB), algo0=zstd, flag0 empty (defaults to max priority 16383)
Enabled zram-init in the default OpenRC runlevel via rc-update add zram-init default
Started the service and confirmed /dev/zram0 swap active at 512M, zstd, priority 16383, with no competing disk-backed swap (empty /etc/fstab swap entries)
Captured baseline boot_id and swap state before restart
Rebooted node1 via `reboot`, backgrounded so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec became available again (~7 minutes)
Verified new boot_id differed from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: zram0 swap active at 512M/zstd/priority 16383, zram-init service started, still enrolled in default runlevel

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB of compressed in-memory swap configured
evidence.summary: zram-init installed and configured with type0=swap, size0=512, algo0=zstd; swapon --show and zramctl confirm /dev/zram0 is a 512M zstd-compressed swap device
rc-update show default lists zram-init in the default runlevel both before and after reboot; post-reboot swapon --show confirms it came up automatically without manual intervention

evidence.requirement: Swap preferred over any disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: zram0 swap has priority 16383 (near-maximum); /etc/fstab shows no disk-backed swap entries, so the zram swap is the only and highest-priority swap device
Captured boot_id 906bf33d-9aa2-4fb4-9ab7-59eb73c8705b and confirmed zram0 swap active (512M, prio 16383) and zram-init service started prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart-evidence protocol: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded `sleep 2; reboot` command returned 'reboot scheduled' acknowledgement immediately, before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart-evidence protocol: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is c7662c73-073a-4a63-8cb6-b8f3785c1340, differing from the pre-restart baseline 906bf33d-9aa2-4fb4-9ab7-59eb73c8705b, proving an actual kernel restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart-evidence protocol: post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: After reboot, /dev/zram0 swap is active again at 512M/zstd/priority 16383, zram-init service status is 'started', and it remains enrolled in the default runlevel — full recovery confirmed with no manual steps
